rows.label: tlk501801_msg0001
rows.name:
All right, today's auction is about
to begin, mo!

rows.label: tlk501801_msg0002
rows.name:
Anyone who hasn't registered yet,
hurry up and apply, mo!

rows.label: tlk501801_msg0003
rows.name:
To take part, bring at least 30,000G,
mo.

rows.label: tlk501801_msg0004
rows.name:
If you don't have enough, I won't let
you join. You couldn't buy anything
anyway, mo...

rows.label: tlk501801_msg0005
rows.name:
Looks like you have enough money...
Now, who will take part...?

rows.label: tlk501801_msg0006
rows.name:
There are many old books today, so
bring someone who seems to like those,
mo.

rows.label: tlk501801_msg0007
rows.name:
Without someone determined to get the
book no matter what, there's no point
in joining, mo.

rows.label: tlk501801_msg0008
rows.name:
Mo-mo... Someone here looks
promising, mo.

rows.label: tlk501801_msg0009
rows.name:
I'm looking forward to today's
auction, mo...
